About me

About me.

I am a Computer Science student in South Africa working towards a Diploma in Computer Science. My main goal is to grow as a software developer and build applications that people find useful.

I enjoy working across interfaces, application logic and databases. Java is one of the technologies in my stack, alongside JavaScript, HTML, CSS and SQL. Cybersecurity is a personal interest of mine.

Away from the keyboard, it's football, gaming, music, or trying something new in the kitchen.
